notes: The כֹּל … לֹא fusion to the single 'no' is defensible under rules 30 and 35 (one English word carrying both the universal and the negation, distance not breaking it), and the note records the competing splits.
'that' (t011) is correctly 'added': the Hebrew writes the antecedent and a finite clause beside it, so rule 46's supplied relative does not reach it and rule 55 governs.
The presentative 'there is' joins סָתוּם as the clause's nominal anchor under rule 20's second sentence; rule 50 is properly excluded, no אַיִן being present.
Variant WLC.EZK.28.3.v001 is underdetermined with the fallback still among the readings the ASV permits, so rule 53 is not engaged and no new textual decision was made.
